Class Player

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.server.model.Player
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Player extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a player in a game session.

Stores the player's resource counters (food, prestige points), their chosen totem colour, their hand of cards keyed by CardType, and transient runtime state (lastPick, isActive, buildingBonus).

Transient fields are not serialised; buildingBonus is rebuilt in readObject after deserialisation. The full-parameter constructor is used only by deserialisers; new players should use the single-name constructor.

    • Player

      public Player(String name)
      Creates a new player with default starting state: zero food, zero prestige points, no totem colour, an empty hand for each CardType, and marked as active.
      Parameters:
      name - the player's username

    • Player

      public Player(String name, int food, int pp, Totem color, Map<CardType, Set<Card>> cards)
      Reconstructs a player from persisted state. Used only by deserialisers recovering a game; new players should use Player(String). The player is initially marked inactive until reconnected.
      Parameters:
      name - the player's username
      food - current food tokens
      pp - current prestige points
      color - the player's chosen totem colour, or null if not yet chosen
      cards - the player's hand, grouped by CardType
